title: Practical Work with the Mind
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating mindfulness in daily life by being aware of one's body and posture, observing thoughts without judgment, and trusting in a larger source that sustains us. By slowing down and paying attention to physical sensations, we can shift our baseline and make even small moments more effective, finding comfort and ease in letting go of self-doubt and anxiety. Regular practice can help us develop a greater sense of trust and confidence, allowing us to navigate life's challenges with greater ease and clarity.
